def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = i XOR j (bitwise XOR of row/col indices).
    # No bitwise ops available -> build XOR per bit arithmetically.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    nbits = max(1, (N - 1).bit_length())
    out = torch.zeros(N, N, device=x.device)
    for b in range(nbits):
        p = float(2 ** b)
        ab = (ii // p) % 2.0
        bb = (jj // p) % 2.0
        out = out + ((ab + bb) % 2.0) * p
    return out.to(x.dtype)

def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = i XOR j (bitwise XOR of row/col indices).
    # Vectorized per-bit XOR built arithmetically (no bitwise ops).
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    nbits = max(1, (N - 1).bit_length())
    coeffs = torch.tensor([float(2 ** b) for b in range(nbits)],
                          device=x.device)
    ai = (idx.view(N, 1, 1) // coeffs) % 2.0
    aj = (idx.view(1, N, 1) // coeffs) % 2.0
    out = (((ai + aj) % 2.0) * coeffs).sum(-1)
    return out.to(x.dtype)
